supportEnvelope.basis: Manually selected outer entrance-step/attached-planter stone-footing support envelope. Visible lower silhouette extrema include the compact entrance forecourt. This is a logical placement envelope, not three exact physical square corners. Rear point is hidden and inferred by parallelogram closure. Approximately +/-10 px.

W.basis: Visible straight outer limestone footing/forecourt edge running right-down; points approximate +/-8 px. Minor planter cut-ins do not establish a recovered physical camera.

D.basis: Visible lower stone planter/footing envelope running right-up. Points approximate +/-8 px. Hidden rear edges and all curved roofs are not claimed to be geometrically exact.

heightReference.basis: Approximate same-x vertical main entrance-side stone pier, from ground-facing contact to the pier cornice, +/-15 px. The higher curved vault/crown extends above this visual ruler; this is not a roof-height or physical-storey measurement.

notes: Original built-in imagegen RGBA PNG preserved byte-for-byte in formal source and runtime copy. No programmatic masking, cropping, recoloring or stretching.
crop is the half-open alpha>8 source bounding box. All four source corner alpha values are zero; render-time low-alpha cleanup remains existing behavior.
Native 3x3 footprint. Main pier targetHeight is 2H to retain a broad landmark footprint; the first suggested 1.5H would reduce the visible support to approximately 1.8x1.7 cells and was not adopted.
Ground support is centered by the existing calibration algorithm, with at least 0.1 cell clearance on each side. Hidden rear support is inferred.
Curved bronze roof is deliberately distinct from plain office blocks. Roof/crown is above the selected main-pier ruler and is not asserted to be exactly 2H overall.
Affine image calibration maps the measured ground axes to +/-0.5 while preserving verticals; this is an approximation and does not recover physical 3D geometry.
